scope: Independent property scenarios for the external liquid film. Values for the reacting four-component mixture remain unavailable. No reactor conversion measurements were used.

source.citation: Moreau et al. (2021), Journal of Molecular Liquids 344, 117744
source.location: Tables 4 and 9, PDF pages 3 and 6, 0.100 MPa rows

viscosity_density.interpolation: Piecewise linear density and log(dynamic viscosity) in absolute temperature

mixture_viscosity_context.citation: Lilja et al. (2005), Chemical Engineering Journal 115, 1–12
mixture_viscosity_context.use: Context for the homologous medium only. Values are not inputs to model cases.

low.citation: Harris, Ganbold and Price (2015), Journal of Chemical & Engineering Data 60, 3506–3517
low.location: Eq. 9 and Figure 5, liquid pentan-1-ol self-diffusion
low.use: Neat-solvent self-diffusion as a slower analogue for bulk acid transport. Its fit uncertainty applies to the self-diffusion experiment.

central.solvent: Pentan-1-ol, with Moreau et al. viscosity

solute_volume_reference.location: La-Scalea, Menezes and Ferreira (2005), Appendix Table A1, Le Bas volume for propionic acid

central.use: Dilute molecular-diffusion estimate. Association factor is a scenario assumption and the actual acid feed is 3.3 mol/L.

high.method: Same Wilke–Chang calculation as central with a larger solvent association factor
high.use: Sensitivity assumption. The scenario is not an upper confidence limit.

same_acid_analogue_source.citation: Liu et al. (2004), Chemical Engineering and Processing 43, 43–47
same_acid_analogue_source.location: Diaphragm-cell measurements of propanoic acid in both water-rich and 1-butanol-rich mutually saturated phases at 298.15 K
same_acid_analogue_source.use: Abstract confirms the measurements. Numerical table was unavailable in the accessible copy and was not used.

wilson_geankoplis.citation: Wilson and Geankoplis (1966), Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Fundamentals 5, 9–14
wilson_geankoplis.superficial_velocity: Volumetric flow divided by empty-bed cross-sectional area
wilson_geankoplis.specimen: Spherical packing. New low-Re liquid experiments used benzoic acid spheres and aqueous propylene glycol.

lorenzo_b2.location: Appendix B, Equation B.2 with the dimensionless Schmidt number
lorenzo_b2.velocity_basis: Superficial, consistent with the source reactor residence-time calculation and the correlation convention
lorenzo_b2.use: Source-equation comparison at the case conditions

isolated_sphere_diffusion.use: Quiescent unbounded liquid around an isolated sphere at steady state. The solution follows from the 1/r concentration field with a fixed surface concentration.
